summary: Saving a monitor now gives clear feedback, so you always know where your change stands.

fixes.title: Notices are always visible
fixes.text: "Add to monitor..." seemed to do nothing because its answer appeared out of sight. Notices now float at the bottom right, wherever you are on the page.

fixes.title: Waiting monitor changes are shown
fixes.text: A new or changed monitor is applied within 5 minutes. The Monitors list now shows what is still waiting, and keeps following it after a reload.

fixes.title: One change never overwrites another
fixes.text: "Add to monitor..." now shows monitors that are saved but not yet applied, and waits until a pending change is done before changing that monitor again.
